intro.en: Routes, flights and ships, kinds of accommodation and the mishaps of a long trip.

el parador.en: the state-run hotel in a historic building

texto.en:
**The route.** **La ruta**, **el itinerario**, **el trayecto** (one leg of the journey). **Recorrer** un país (to travel all over it), **atravesar** or **cruzar** el océano, **dar la vuelta al mundo**.

**Kinds of trip.** **Un viaje de negocios**, **de placer**, **de novios**. **Turismo rural**, **cultural**, **de aventura**. **Un crucero**.

**By air.** **Un vuelo directo** or **con escala**; **nacional** or **internacional**. **Hacer escala en** Lisboa. **Embarcar** and **desembarcar**. **La tripulación** looks after **los pasajeros**. A flight can be **anunciado**, **retrasado** or **cancelado**.

**At the border.** **Cruzar la frontera**, **pasar la aduana**, **declarar** what you are carrying, **pasar el control**.

**Luggage.** **Facturar**, **registrar** (to search), **extraviar**: **me han extraviado la maleta**. You can leave bags in **la consigna**.

**Where to sleep.** **Un hotel**, **un hostal**, **un albergue** (cheap, shared), **un parador** (a state-run hotel in a castle, convent or palace: a Spanish institution), **una casa rural**, **un bungaló**. Or you **acampas** and **montas la tienda de campaña**.

**The verbs.** **Alojarse en**, **registrarse**, **tener vistas a**, **dar a**.

**By sea.** **Un barco de vela**, **un ferry**, **un barco pesquero**. **Marearse** is what happens to bad sailors.

frases.es: A los cincuenta años, Ignacio dejó su trabajo para dar la vuelta al mundo sin subirse a un avión.
frases.en: At fifty, Ignacio left his job to go round the world without getting on a plane.
analisis: para dar la vuelta al mundo

frases.es: Había calculado un itinerario de ocho meses, pero el viaje acabó durando casi el doble.
frases.en: He had worked out an itinerary of eight months, but the journey ended up lasting almost twice that.

frases.es: Atravesó Europa y Asia en tren, alojándose en albergues y, cuando no los había, acampando donde podía.
frases.en: He crossed Europe and Asia by train, staying in hostels and, when there were none, camping wherever he could.

frases.es: El trayecto más difícil fue el del Pacífico: tardó un mes en encontrar un barco de carga que admitiera pasajeros.
frases.en: The hardest leg was the Pacific one: it took him a month to find a cargo ship that would take passengers.

frases.es: La tripulación, de seis nacionalidades, lo adoptó enseguida, aunque él se pasó mareado la primera semana.
frases.en: The crew, of six nationalities, adopted him at once, although he spent the first week seasick.

frases.es: En una aduana le registraron la mochila durante horas, y en otra le extraviaron el pasaporte.
frases.en: At one customs post they searched his backpack for hours, and at another they mislaid his passport.

frases.es: Cuando le preguntan si lo repetiría, contesta que, de haber sabido lo que le esperaba, no habría salido, y que por eso se alegra de no haberlo sabido.
frases.en: When he is asked whether he would do it again, he answers that, had he known what awaited him, he would not have set off, and that this is why he is glad not to have known.
analisis: se alegra de no haberlo sabido

pregunta.en: According to the text, what was the hardest part of the journey?

Crossing the Pacific.en: El trayecto más difícil fue el del Pacífico.

Crossing Asia by train.en: He did that without great trouble.

Getting through customs.en: That was a problem, but not the hardest part.

pregunta.en: According to the text, how long did the trip take?

Almost sixteen months.en: Eight months planned, and almost double in the end.

A month.en: That was the wait for a ship.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write a travel article about a long journey, real or imagined, with its route, incidents and people.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Tell aloud the worst travel experience of your life, with all the details.
